title: Moetapele ea Khethiloeng oa Sechaba
intro: Nakong ea phephetso e kholo le ho nyahama ha batho, ho ile ha etsoa kopano ea bomolimo. Motho enoa, eo qalong a neng a hlokomolohuoa ke ba bangata, o ile a khethoa ke Allah ho etella pele sechaba khahlanong le sera se matla. Pale ea bona ke bopaki ba matla a tumelo le bohlale bo ka morao ho taelo ea bomolimo, bo bontšang hore boetapele ba 'nete ha bo fumanehe kamehla libakeng tse lebelletsoeng.
clues: Ke khethiloe ke Allah ho ba moetapele oa batho ba ka ha ba ne ba batla 'musi ea tla loana molemong oa Hae.
Qalong batho ba heso ba ne ba belaella ho khethoa ha ka, ba ikutloa eka ba bang ba tšoaneleha haholoanyane ka lebaka la leruo la bona kapa leloko la bona.
Letšoao la boetapele ba ka bo nepahetseng e ne e le ho khutla ha lebokose le halalelang, le nang le mesaletsa ea baprofeta ba pele, e leng se ileng sa tlisa khutso.
Ke ile ka etella pele lebotho la ka ho ea nokeng, moo ke ileng ka leka kutlo ea bona ka ho ba thibela ho noa metsi a fetang khaba e le 'ngoe.
Ho sa tsotellehe palo e nyenyane ea ba ileng ba lula ba tiile ka mor'a teko, re ile ra tobana le mohlabani ea matla le lebotho la bona.
Tlas'a taolo ea ka, mohlankana e mong oa lebotho la ka, eo e neng e se mohlabani ea tummeng, o ile a tobana le 'mampoli oa sera ea matla ka sebete' me a mo hlola.

trial.label: Nyeoe/Ketsahalo
options: Ho khethoa e le moetapele khahlanong le senatla
Moroallo o ileng oa koahela naha
trial.answer: Ho khethoa e le moetapele khahlanong le senatla

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: 'Muso o ile oa theoa ka leruo le matla a maholo.
Batho ba ile ba khangoa ke moroallo o moholo.
Mohlabani oa sera o ile a hloloa, 'me Allah a mo fa tlhōlo.
Komello e kholo e ile ea hlasela naha ka lilemo tse ngata.
Moetapele o ile a metsoa ke sebopuoa se seholo.
outcome.answer: Mohlabani oa sera o ile a hloloa, 'me Allah a mo fa tlhōlo.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
